03-ai-in-marketing.md.title: AI in Digital Marketing — The 2026 Landscape
03-ai-in-marketing.md.description: Module 06 — Analytics, Strategy & Career Readiness | Topic 3 --- AI has gone from a buzzword to a daily tool for digital marketers.
